title: Automorphisms of hypersurfaces in polarized varieties
summary: Let $F$ be a projective variety, let $H$ be a normally generated line bundle on $F$, and let $X\in |H^{\otimes d}|$ be a general projective variety. We establish a uniform criterion, formulated in terms of the graded Betti numbers of the section ring $R(F,H)$, that provides sufficient conditions for every automorphism of $X$ to extend to an automorphism of $F$.
